criteria.note: wq#1810 despag P1-5: workspace = git worktree per session. ensure_workspace() (despag/workspace.py:223-259) is the session-implicit-on-first-task path (lifecycle.md): a fresh sid gets `git worktree add` against the harness's declared repo (repo_for_harness()/ensure_scratch_repo(), despag/workspace.py:132-147; harnesses.yaml now carries a `repo:` key, despag/harnesses.yaml), a HOME-redirect `.harness/home` dir, a secret-safe .gitignore, and an initial `--allow-empty` commit; a sid whose directory the TTL reaper already collected raises SessionExpired (despag/workspace.py:115-119) instead of silently starting a discontinuous session. TTL/mtime reap: reap_stale() (despag/workspace.py:192-219) deletes only directories idle past DESPAG_WORKSPACE_TTL_HOURS AND without a live control-store lease (control.lease_is_live(), the new method added at despag/backing/control_sqlite.py:241-255) — runs inline at session-create time (ensure_workspace, line 237) and via `python3 -m despag reap` (despag/__main__.py). Checkpoint/rehydrate: checkpoint() (despag/workspace.py:309-345) commits, tars with .git/.claude/.credentials.json/.env/tmp/node_modules/.venv/__pycache__ excluded at any depth (CHECKPOINT_EXCLUDE, despag/workspace.py:288-291), spools to disk, sha256s, and stores via BlobStore as sessions/<sid>/workspace.tgz; rehydrate() (despag/workspace.py:348-385) honours a probe=<sha> short-circuit and always re-establishes the worktree link before untarring. Collection cursor: advance_cursor() (despag/workspace.py:402-414) is the ONLY function that moves refs/lumen/collected — checkpoint()'s commit deliberately never touches it (E.4). D.1 snapshot: build_snapshot()/capture_and_store_snapshot()/previous_snapshot() (despag/workspace.py:474-547) build the bounded (<=64KB) {type:system, subtype:workspace_snapshot} frame, store it as sessions/<sid>/snapshots/<resp_id>.json, and feed exactly the most recent one forward to the session's next task. Unit tests: python3 -m pytest despag/tests/test_workspace.py -> 10 passed (TTL reaps only stale+unleased: test_reap_stale_reaps_only_stale_and_unleased; checkpoint excludes credentials: test_checkpoint_excludes_credentials; cursor advances only on ack: test_cursor_advances_only_on_ack; crash between capture and ack reproduces the same delta: test_crash_between_capture_and_ack_reproduces_same_delta; C-01 continuation carries previous snapshot: test_previous_snapshot_carries_forward_exactly_one). Full suite: python3 -m pytest despag/tests/ -> 72 passed, 0 failed (62 pre-existing + 10 new), confirming no regression to despag/app.py's discovery/harness/control-plane surface.
